columns.comment: Calendar month of the exposure month-end as its first day (DATE): September 2026 = DATE'2026-09-01' (the month-end snapshot as of 30-Sep-2026). This view is monthly; point-in-time measures grouped by a longer period (quarter, half, fiscal year) return its last month. The latest month is Sep 2026.
columns.name: Month

columns.comment: Japanese fiscal year label of the exposure month-end, April to March: FY2026 = Apr 2026 - Mar 2027, FY2025 = Apr 2025 - Mar 2026. "This year" / YTD = FY2026 to 30-Sep-2026; year-on-year compares the same months of FY2025.
columns.name: Fiscal Year

columns.comment: Japanese fiscal quarter label, e.g. FY2026-Q2: Q1 = Apr-Jun, Q2 = Jul-Sep, Q3 = Oct-Dec, Q4 = Jan-Mar (FY2026-Q4 = Jan-Mar 2027). The latest quarter is FY2026-Q2 (Jul-Sep 2026).
columns.name: Fiscal Quarter

columns.comment: Japanese fiscal half label, e.g. FY2026-H1: H1 = Apr-Sep, H2 = Oct-Mar. H1 FY2026 (Apr-Sep 2026) closed on 30-Sep-2026; compare with FY2025-H1 for year-on-year.
columns.name: Fiscal Half

columns.comment: Always true here: this view is monthly, every row is a month-end snapshot or a whole-month total (kept so the same filter works in daily and monthly views).
columns.name: Is Month End

columns.comment: True for September 2026, the latest (as-of) month - use it for "today", "current", "latest" or "right now" questions on balances and other point-in-time measures.
columns.name: Is Latest Month

columns.comment: Client group = the global parent group, as its short brand (e.g. Kinokawa Precision, Hayashi Marine Logistics, Sunda Energi Nusantara). "Client" or "group" without qualification means this level. Match names with LIKE '%Kinokawa%'. About 380 groups.
columns.name: Client Group

columns.comment: Legal entity (golden client) with its location, e.g. Kinokawa Precision (Singapore) Pte Ltd - "entity" or "subsidiary" means this level. About 2,500 entities; match with LIKE '%Kinokawa%Singapore%'.
columns.name: Client

columns.comment: Client segment: Japanese Corporate, Non-Japanese Large Corporate, Financial Institution, Sponsor & Structured Finance or Public Sector.
columns.name: Segment

columns.comment: Relationship tier - Strategic, Core or Transactional. "Strategic clients" means Relationship Tier = Strategic.
columns.name: Relationship Tier

columns.comment: True for APAC subsidiaries of Japanese groups (segment Japanese Corporate) - "Japanese corporates", "JC" or "Japanese clients" means true.
columns.name: Is Japanese Corporate

columns.comment: Industry sector of the APAC taxonomy (e.g. Technology, Materials, Energy, Industrials); see Subsector.
columns.name: Industry

columns.comment: Industry subsector within the sector (e.g. Semiconductors, Automotive Parts, Coal Mining, Shipping).
columns.name: Subsector

columns.comment: Booking country of the exposure = the client's coverage office (ISO-2: SG Singapore, HK Hong Kong, CN, TH, ID, IN, AU, VN, MY, KR, TW, PH, NZ) - "booking country" and "country" in delinquency questions mean this.
columns.name: Coverage Office

columns.comment: Primary relationship manager (fictional name) at the row's month-end: the CRM primary-RM assignment, else the group account-plan owner; null = no RM coverage.
columns.name: Primary RM

columns.comment: Office (APAC booking location, ISO-2) where the primary RM sits - "RMs in Singapore / Hong Kong" means this (most RMs also cover clients booked in other countries, so it differs from Coverage Office).
columns.name: Primary RM Office

columns.comment: Internal rating grade 1-10 in force at the row's month-end (1 best, 10 default; 7 and worse is sub-investment watch territory); null = not rated (no credit relationship).
columns.name: Rating Grade

columns.comment: IFRS 9 stage at the row's month-end: 1 performing, 2 significant increase in credit risk, 3 credit-impaired / default; null = not rated.
columns.name: IFRS 9 Stage

columns.comment: True when the client is on the credit watchlist at the row's month-end ("not on the watchlist" = false).
columns.name: Watchlist

columns.comment: KYC / AML risk rating Low, Medium or High at the row's month-end (latest completed review); null = no KYC record.
columns.name: KYC Risk Rating

columns.comment: Final early-warning band at the row's month-end: Green (score < 40), Amber (40-69) or Red (>= 70), after overrides; null = not scored (no credit relationship, or before Apr-2025).
columns.name: EWS Band

columns.comment: Days-past-due bucket at the month-end: Current, 1-29, 30-59, 60-89 or 90+ (90+ = default territory).
columns.name: DPD Bucket

columns.comment: Term Loan, Revolving Credit Facility, Syndicated Loan, Bilateral Loan, Overdraft or Trade Loan.
columns.name: Facility Type

columns.comment: Credit facility id (FAC-nnnnnn).
columns.name: Facility

columns.comment: True when the facility is 30 or more days past due at the month-end.
columns.name: Is 30 Plus DPD

columns.comment: True from Apr-2024, when EAD, RWA and ECL are available; earlier months carry balances and DPD only.
columns.name: Has Capital Measures

columns.comment: Drawn (outstanding) lending at the month-end, USD (point-in-time).
columns.name: Drawn USD

columns.comment: Committed facility limits at the month-end, USD (point-in-time).
columns.name: Limit USD

columns.comment: Facilities with a balance record at the month-end (point-in-time).
columns.name: Facilities

columns.comment: Facilities past due (DPD > 0) at the month-end (point-in-time).
columns.name: Facilities Overdue

columns.comment: Clients with at least one facility past due at the month-end (point-in-time).
columns.name: Clients Overdue

columns.comment: Amount past due on the month-end day, USD (point-in-time).
columns.name: Overdue Amount USD

columns.comment: Drawn exposure of facilities 30 or more days past due at the month-end, USD (point-in-time).
columns.name: Drawn 30 Plus DPD USD

columns.comment: Drawn exposure 30+ days past due / total drawn exposure at the month-end (fraction) - the 30+ DPD rate.
columns.name: 30+ DPD Rate %

columns.comment: Facilities 30 or more days past due at the month-end (point-in-time).
columns.name: Facilities 30 Plus DPD

columns.comment: Facilities 30+ days past due / facilities at the month-end (fraction).
columns.name: 30+ DPD Rate by Count %

columns.comment: Drawn exposure more than 90 days past due (default) / total drawn at the month-end (fraction).
columns.name: 90+ DPD Rate %

columns.comment: Facility-months in which an arrears episode was cured (arrears cleared) - a flow over months.
columns.name: Facilities Cured

columns.comment: Facility-months with any day past due - the denominator of the cure rate (a flow).
columns.name: Facilities in Arrears

columns.comment: Facilities cured in the month / facilities in arrears during the month (fraction); over several months a pooled rate.
columns.name: Cure Rate %

columns.comment: Exposure at default at the month-end, USD (from Apr-2024; point-in-time).
columns.name: EAD USD

columns.comment: Risk-weighted assets at the month-end, USD (from Apr-2024; point-in-time).
columns.name: RWA USD

columns.comment: IFRS 9 expected credit loss provision held at the month-end, USD (12-month in Stage 1, lifetime in Stages 2-3; from Apr-2024).
columns.name: ECL USD

columns.comment: Change in the ECL provision over the selected months, USD (positive = provision build) - a flow.
columns.name: ECL Change USD

columns.comment: Drawn exposure of Stage 3 (credit-impaired) obligors at the month-end, USD (from Apr-2024).
columns.name: Stage 3 Exposure USD

comment: Credit exposure and delinquency of SMBC APAC lending at each month-end, Apr-2023 to Sep-2026: drawn and limit, facilities and clients overdue, overdue amount, 30+ and 90+ DPD rates (drawn-weighted and by facility count), DPD bucket, cures and the cure rate, EAD, RWA, IFRS 9 ECL and Stage 3 exposure (capital measures from Apr-2024). Booking country = the client's Coverage Office. Balances and DPD positions are POINT-IN-TIME: filter or group by Month (Is Latest Month = Sep 2026); a quarter or year returns its last month-end. Cures and ECL change are flows. Grain: one row per facility per month-end (gold.fact_credit_exposure_monthly).
